## 562. pypde\docs\reference\de\tech\_autosummary\keysight.ads.de._pde.tech.ProcessRole.md {#pypde--docs--reference--de--tech--_autosummary--keysight.ads.de._pde.tech.processrole}

# ProcessRole[](#processrole "Link to this heading")

*class* ProcessRole[](#keysight.ads.de._pde.tech.ProcessRole "Link to this definition")
:   Bases: `Enum`

    Describes the role of a layer - the meaning of shapes on that layer.

    Attributes

    |  |  |
    | --- | --- |
    | [`NOT_DEFINED`](#keysight.ads.de._pde.tech.ProcessRole.NOT_DEFINED "keysight.ads.de._pde.tech.ProcessRole.NOT_DEFINED") | `'NotDefined'` The layer has no process role defined so shapes have no meaning. |
    | [`NONE`](#keysight.ads.de._pde.tech.ProcessRole.NONE "keysight.ads.de._pde.tech.ProcessRole.NONE") | `'None'` Deprecated alias for NOT\_DEFINED. |
    | [`CONDUCTOR`](#keysight.ads.de._pde.tech.ProcessRole.CONDUCTOR "keysight.ads.de._pde.tech.ProcessRole.CONDUCTOR") | `'Conductor'` Shapes on layers with this role represent conductors. |
    | [`SEMICONDUCTOR`](#keysight.ads.de._pde.tech.ProcessRole.SEMICONDUCTOR "keysight.ads.de._pde.tech.ProcessRole.SEMICONDUCTOR") | `'Semiconductor'` Shapes on layers with this role represent semi-conductors and don't connect electrically. |
    | [`DIELECTRIC`](#keysight.ads.de._pde.tech.ProcessRole.DIELECTRIC "keysight.ads.de._pde.tech.ProcessRole.DIELECTRIC") | `'Dielectric'` Shapes on layers with this role represent dielectrics and don't connect electrically. |
    | [`CONDUCTOR_VIA`](#keysight.ads.de._pde.tech.ProcessRole.CONDUCTOR_VIA "keysight.ads.de._pde.tech.ProcessRole.CONDUCTOR_VIA") | `'ConductorVia'` Shapes on layers with this role represent conductor vias and don't connect electrically. |
    | [`SEMICONDUCTOR_VIA`](#keysight.ads.de._pde.tech.ProcessRole.SEMICONDUCTOR_VIA "keysight.ads.de._pde.tech.ProcessRole.SEMICONDUCTOR_VIA") | `'SemiconductorVia'` Shapes on layers with this role represent semi-conductor vias and don't connect electrically. |
    | [`DIELECTRIC_VIA`](#keysight.ads.de._pde.tech.ProcessRole.DIELECTRIC_VIA "keysight.ads.de._pde.tech.ProcessRole.DIELECTRIC_VIA") | `'DielectricVia'` Shapes on layers with this role represent dielectric vias and don't connect electrically. |
    | [`CONDUCTOR_SLOT`](#keysight.ads.de._pde.tech.ProcessRole.CONDUCTOR_SLOT "keysight.ads.de._pde.tech.ProcessRole.CONDUCTOR_SLOT") | `'ConductorSlot'` Shapes on layers with this role represent a slot in a conductor layer. |
    | [`SEMICONDUCTOR_SLOT`](#keysight.ads.de._pde.tech.ProcessRole.SEMICONDUCTOR_SLOT "keysight.ads.de._pde.tech.ProcessRole.SEMICONDUCTOR_SLOT") | `'SemiconductorSlot'` Shapes on layers with this role represent a slot in a semi-conductor layer. |
    | [`DIELECTRIC_SLOT`](#keysight.ads.de._pde.tech.ProcessRole.DIELECTRIC_SLOT "keysight.ads.de._pde.tech.ProcessRole.DIELECTRIC_SLOT") | `'DielectricSlot'` Shapes on layers with this role represent a slot in a dielectric layer. |
    | [`DRC`](#keysight.ads.de._pde.tech.ProcessRole.DRC "keysight.ads.de._pde.tech.ProcessRole.DRC") | `'DRC'` Shapes on layers with this role represent errors reported by the design rule checker. |
    | [`BOUNDARY`](#keysight.ads.de._pde.tech.ProcessRole.BOUNDARY "keysight.ads.de._pde.tech.ProcessRole.BOUNDARY") | `'Boundary'` Shapes on layers with this role represent bounding regions. |
    | [`HEAT_SOURCE`](#keysight.ads.de._pde.tech.ProcessRole.HEAT_SOURCE "keysight.ads.de._pde.tech.ProcessRole.HEAT_SOURCE") | `'HeatSource'` Shapes on layers with this role represent heat sources. |
    | [`COMPONENT_BODY`](#keysight.ads.de._pde.tech.ProcessRole.COMPONENT_BODY "keysight.ads.de._pde.tech.ProcessRole.COMPONENT_BODY") | `'ComponentBody'` Shapes on layers with this role represent the body of a component. |
    | [`ANNOT_INSTANCE_NAME`](#keysight.ads.de._pde.tech.ProcessRole.ANNOT_INSTANCE_NAME "keysight.ads.de._pde.tech.ProcessRole.ANNOT_INSTANCE_NAME") | `'InstanceName'` Shapes on layers with this role are used for instance name annotation. |
    | [`ANNOT_COMPONENT_NAME`](#keysight.ads.de._pde.tech.ProcessRole.ANNOT_COMPONENT_NAME "keysight.ads.de._pde.tech.ProcessRole.ANNOT_COMPONENT_NAME") | `'ComponentName'` Shapes on layers with this role are used for component name annotation. |
    | [`ANNOT_OTHER`](#keysight.ads.de._pde.tech.ProcessRole.ANNOT_OTHER "keysight.ads.de._pde.tech.ProcessRole.ANNOT_OTHER") | `'Annotation'` Shapes on layers with this role are used for general annotation. |
    | [`SOLDER_MASK`](#keysight.ads.de._pde.tech.ProcessRole.SOLDER_MASK "keysight.ads.de._pde.tech.ProcessRole.SOLDER_MASK") | `'SolderMask'` The layer represents a solder mask. |
    | [`SOLDER_PASTE`](#keysight.ads.de._pde.tech.ProcessRole.SOLDER_PASTE "keysight.ads.de._pde.tech.ProcessRole.SOLDER_PASTE") | `'SolderPaste'` The layer represents solder paste. |
    | [`SILK_SCREEN`](#keysight.ads.de._pde.tech.ProcessRole.SILK_SCREEN "keysight.ads.de._pde.tech.ProcessRole.SILK_SCREEN") | `'SilkScreen'` The layer contains text and annotation intended for manufacturing. |
    | [`SCRATCH`](#keysight.ads.de._pde.tech.ProcessRole.SCRATCH "keysight.ads.de._pde.tech.ProcessRole.SCRATCH") | `'Scratch'` The layer is used for temporary editing. |
    | [`OTHER`](#keysight.ads.de._pde.tech.ProcessRole.OTHER "keysight.ads.de._pde.tech.ProcessRole.OTHER") | `'Other'` The layer has a role not covered by the other values but is intended for manufacturing. |
    | [`str`](#keysight.ads.de._pde.tech.ProcessRole.str "keysight.ads.de._pde.tech.ProcessRole.str") | Return the string representation of the ProcessRole. |

    NOT\_DEFINED *= 0*[](#keysight.ads.de._pde.tech.ProcessRole.NOT_DEFINED "Link to this definition")
    :   `'NotDefined'` The layer has no process role defined so shapes have no meaning.

    NONE *= 0*[](#keysight.ads.de._pde.tech.ProcessRole.NONE "Link to this definition")
    :   `'None'` Deprecated alias for NOT\_DEFINED.

    CONDUCTOR *= 1*[](#keysight.ads.de._pde.tech.ProcessRole.CONDUCTOR "Link to this definition")
    :   `'Conductor'` Shapes on layers with this role represent conductors.

    SEMICONDUCTOR *= 2*[](#keysight.ads.de._pde.tech.ProcessRole.SEMICONDUCTOR "Link to this definition")
    :   `'Semiconductor'` Shapes on layers with this role represent semi-conductors and don’t connect electrically.

    DIELECTRIC *= 3*[](#keysight.ads.de._pde.tech.ProcessRole.DIELECTRIC "Link to this definition")
    :   `'Dielectric'` Shapes on layers with this role represent dielectrics and don’t connect electrically.

    CONDUCTOR\_VIA *= 4*[](#keysight.ads.de._pde.tech.ProcessRole.CONDUCTOR_VIA "Link to this definition")
    :   `'ConductorVia'` Shapes on layers with this role represent conductor vias and don’t connect electrically.

    SEMICONDUCTOR\_VIA *= 5*[](#keysight.ads.de._pde.tech.ProcessRole.SEMICONDUCTOR_VIA "Link to this definition")
    :   `'SemiconductorVia'` Shapes on layers with this role represent semi-conductor vias and don’t connect electrically.

    DIELECTRIC\_VIA *= 6*[](#keysight.ads.de._pde.tech.ProcessRole.DIELECTRIC_VIA "Link to this definition")
    :   `'DielectricVia'` Shapes on layers with this role represent dielectric vias and don’t connect electrically.

    CONDUCTOR\_SLOT *= 7*[](#keysight.ads.de._pde.tech.ProcessRole.CONDUCTOR_SLOT "Link to this definition")
    :   `'ConductorSlot'` Shapes on layers with this role represent a slot in a conductor layer.
        Slot layers are ignored by layout connectivity.

    SEMICONDUCTOR\_SLOT *= 8*[](#keysight.ads.de._pde.tech.ProcessRole.SEMICONDUCTOR_SLOT "Link to this definition")
    :   `'SemiconductorSlot'` Shapes on layers with this role represent a slot in a semi-conductor layer.
        Slot layers are ignored by layout connectivity.

    DIELECTRIC\_SLOT *= 9*[](#keysight.ads.de._pde.tech.ProcessRole.DIELECTRIC_SLOT "Link to this definition")
    :   `'DielectricSlot'` Shapes on layers with this role represent a slot in a dielectric layer.
        Slot layers are ignored by layout connectivity.

    DRC *= 10*[](#keysight.ads.de._pde.tech.ProcessRole.DRC "Link to this definition")
    :   `'DRC'` Shapes on layers with this role represent errors reported by the design rule checker.

    BOUNDARY *= 11*[](#keysight.ads.de._pde.tech.ProcessRole.BOUNDARY "Link to this definition")
    :   `'Boundary'` Shapes on layers with this role represent bounding regions.

    HEAT\_SOURCE *= 12*[](#keysight.ads.de._pde.tech.ProcessRole.HEAT_SOURCE "Link to this definition")
    :   `'HeatSource'` Shapes on layers with this role represent heat sources.

    COMPONENT\_BODY *= 13*[](#keysight.ads.de._pde.tech.ProcessRole.COMPONENT_BODY "Link to this definition")
    :   `'ComponentBody'` Shapes on layers with this role represent the body of a component.

    ANNOT\_INSTANCE\_NAME *= 15*[](#keysight.ads.de._pde.tech.ProcessRole.ANNOT_INSTANCE_NAME "Link to this definition")
    :   `'InstanceName'` Shapes on layers with this role are used for instance name annotation.
        Annotation layers are not usually included in manufacturing.

    ANNOT\_COMPONENT\_NAME *= 16*[](#keysight.ads.de._pde.tech.ProcessRole.ANNOT_COMPONENT_NAME "Link to this definition")
    :   `'ComponentName'` Shapes on layers with this role are used for component name annotation.
        Annotation layers are not usually included in manufacturing.

    ANNOT\_OTHER *= 17*[](#keysight.ads.de._pde.tech.ProcessRole.ANNOT_OTHER "Link to this definition")
    :   `'Annotation'` Shapes on layers with this role are used for general annotation.
        Annotation layers are not usually included in manufacturing.

    SOLDER\_MASK *= 18*[](#keysight.ads.de._pde.tech.ProcessRole.SOLDER_MASK "Link to this definition")
    :   `'SolderMask'` The layer represents a solder mask.
        This is a negative layer so shapes on layers with this role cause an absence of solder.

    SOLDER\_PASTE *= 19*[](#keysight.ads.de._pde.tech.ProcessRole.SOLDER_PASTE "Link to this definition")
    :   `'SolderPaste'` The layer represents solder paste.
        This is a positive layer so shapes on layers with this role cause the presence of solder paste.

    SILK\_SCREEN *= 20*[](#keysight.ads.de._pde.tech.ProcessRole.SILK_SCREEN "Link to this definition")
    :   `'SilkScreen'` The layer contains text and annotation intended for manufacturing.

    SCRATCH *= 21*[](#keysight.ads.de._pde.tech.ProcessRole.SCRATCH "Link to this definition")
    :   `'Scratch'` The layer is used for temporary editing.
        Scratch layers are not included in manufacturing output.

    OTHER *= 22*[](#keysight.ads.de._pde.tech.ProcessRole.OTHER "Link to this definition")
    :   `'Other'` The layer has a role not covered by the other values but is intended for manufacturing.

    *property* str[](#keysight.ads.de._pde.tech.ProcessRole.str "Link to this definition")
    :   Return the string representation of the ProcessRole.


---

## 570. pypde\docs\reference\de\tech\_autosummary\keysight.ads.de._pde.tech.LineCornerType.md {#pypde--docs--reference--de--tech--_autosummary--keysight.ads.de._pde.tech.linecornertype}

# LineCornerType[](#linecornertype "Link to this heading")

*class* LineCornerType[](#keysight.ads.de._pde.tech.LineCornerType "Link to this definition")
:   Bases: `Enum`

    Defines the type of corners used by LineTypeInfo.

    Attributes

    |  |  |
    | --- | --- |
    | [`SQUARE`](#keysight.ads.de._pde.tech.LineCornerType.SQUARE "keysight.ads.de._pde.tech.LineCornerType.SQUARE") | `'Square'` The line has square corners. |
    | [`MITERED`](#keysight.ads.de._pde.tech.LineCornerType.MITERED "keysight.ads.de._pde.tech.LineCornerType.MITERED") | `'Mitered'` The line has mitered corners - prefer ADAPTIVE\_MITERED. |
    | [`ADAPTIVE_MITERED`](#keysight.ads.de._pde.tech.LineCornerType.ADAPTIVE_MITERED "keysight.ads.de._pde.tech.LineCornerType.ADAPTIVE_MITERED") | `'Adaptive Mitered'` The line has mitered corners with consistent cut length. |
    | [`CURVED`](#keysight.ads.de._pde.tech.LineCornerType.CURVED "keysight.ads.de._pde.tech.LineCornerType.CURVED") | `'Curved'` The line has curved corners with a specified radius. |
    | [`ROUND`](#keysight.ads.de._pde.tech.LineCornerType.ROUND "keysight.ads.de._pde.tech.LineCornerType.ROUND") | `'Round'` The line has rounded corners. |
    | [`str`](#keysight.ads.de._pde.tech.LineCornerType.str "keysight.ads.de._pde.tech.LineCornerType.str") | Return the string representation of the Line Corner Type. |

    SQUARE *= 0*[](#keysight.ads.de._pde.tech.LineCornerType.SQUARE "Link to this definition")
    :   `'Square'` The line has square corners.

    MITERED *= 1*[](#keysight.ads.de._pde.tech.LineCornerType.MITERED "Link to this definition")
    :   `'Mitered'` The line has mitered corners - prefer ADAPTIVE\_MITERED.

    ADAPTIVE\_MITERED *= 2*[](#keysight.ads.de._pde.tech.LineCornerType.ADAPTIVE_MITERED "Link to this definition")
    :   `'Adaptive Mitered'` The line has mitered corners with consistent cut length.

    CURVED *= 3*[](#keysight.ads.de._pde.tech.LineCornerType.CURVED "Link to this definition")
    :   `'Curved'` The line has curved corners with a specified radius.

    ROUND *= 4*[](#keysight.ads.de._pde.tech.LineCornerType.ROUND "Link to this definition")
    :   `'Round'` The line has rounded corners.

    *property* str[](#keysight.ads.de._pde.tech.LineCornerType.str "Link to this definition")

    | [`Mode`](_autosummary/keysight.ads.de._pde.tech.Thermal.Mode.md#keysight.ads.de._pde.tech.Thermal.Mode "keysight.ads.de._pde.tech.Thermal.Mode") | Defines the mode of a Thermal Relief. |

    *class* Mode[](#keysight.ads.de.tech.pads.Thermal.Mode "Link to this definition")
    :   Bases: `pybind11_object`

        Defines the mode of a Thermal Relief.

        Members:

        > USE\_DEFAULT : ‘UseDefault’: Use the thermal mode defined in the default PadLayerEntry.
        >
        > FULL\_CONNECT : ‘FullConnect’: The pad is fully connected to the plane. There is no thermal relief.
        >
        > STRAIGHT : ‘Straight’: The thermal has 4 spokes. The clearance is drawn with straight lines.
        >
        > EXACT : ‘Exact’: The thermal has 4 spokes. The clearance is drawn with with rounded corners to keep exact distance.
        >
        > STRAIGHT\_2 : ‘Straight2’: The thermal has 2 spokes. The clearance is drawn with straight lines.
        >
        > EXACT\_2 : ‘Exact2’: The thermal has 2 spokes. The clearance is drawn with with rounded corners to keep exact distance.

        EXACT *= <Mode.EXACT: 4>*[](#keysight.ads.de.tech.pads.Thermal.Mode.EXACT "Link to this definition")
        :   `'Exact'` The thermal has 4 spokes. The clearance is drawn with with rounded corners to keep exact distance.

        EXACT\_2 *= <Mode.EXACT\_2: 7>*[](#keysight.ads.de.tech.pads.Thermal.Mode.EXACT_2 "Link to this definition")
        :   `'Exact2'` The thermal has 2 spokes. The clearance is drawn with with rounded corners to keep exact distance.

        FULL\_CONNECT *= <Mode.FULL\_CONNECT: 1>*[](#keysight.ads.de.tech.pads.Thermal.Mode.FULL_CONNECT "Link to this definition")
        :   `'FullConnect'` The pad is fully connected to the plane. There is no thermal relief.

        STRAIGHT *= <Mode.STRAIGHT: 3>*[](#keysight.ads.de.tech.pads.Thermal.Mode.STRAIGHT "Link to this definition")
        :   `'Straight'` The thermal has 4 spokes. The clearance is drawn with straight lines.

        STRAIGHT\_2 *= <Mode.STRAIGHT\_2: 6>*[](#keysight.ads.de.tech.pads.Thermal.Mode.STRAIGHT_2 "Link to this definition")
        :   `'Straight2'` The thermal has 2 spokes. The clearance is drawn with straight lines.

        USE\_DEFAULT *= <Mode.USE\_DEFAULT: 0>*[](#keysight.ads.de.tech.pads.Thermal.Mode.USE_DEFAULT "Link to this definition")
        :   `'UseDefault'` Use the thermal mode defined in the default PadLayerEntry.

# Mode[](#mode "Link to this heading")

*class* Mode[](#keysight.ads.de._pde.tech.Thermal.Mode "Link to this definition")
:   Bases: `Enum`

    Defines the mode of a Thermal Relief.

    Attributes

    |  |  |
    | --- | --- |
    | [`USE_DEFAULT`](#keysight.ads.de._pde.tech.Thermal.Mode.USE_DEFAULT "keysight.ads.de._pde.tech.Thermal.Mode.USE_DEFAULT") | `'UseDefault'` Use the thermal mode defined in the default PadLayerEntry. |
    | [`FULL_CONNECT`](#keysight.ads.de._pde.tech.Thermal.Mode.FULL_CONNECT "keysight.ads.de._pde.tech.Thermal.Mode.FULL_CONNECT") | `'FullConnect'` The pad is fully connected to the plane. |
    | [`STRAIGHT`](#keysight.ads.de._pde.tech.Thermal.Mode.STRAIGHT "keysight.ads.de._pde.tech.Thermal.Mode.STRAIGHT") | `'Straight'` The thermal has 4 spokes. |
    | [`EXACT`](#keysight.ads.de._pde.tech.Thermal.Mode.EXACT "keysight.ads.de._pde.tech.Thermal.Mode.EXACT") | `'Exact'` The thermal has 4 spokes. |
    | [`STRAIGHT_2`](#keysight.ads.de._pde.tech.Thermal.Mode.STRAIGHT_2 "keysight.ads.de._pde.tech.Thermal.Mode.STRAIGHT_2") | `'Straight2'` The thermal has 2 spokes. |
    | [`EXACT_2`](#keysight.ads.de._pde.tech.Thermal.Mode.EXACT_2 "keysight.ads.de._pde.tech.Thermal.Mode.EXACT_2") | `'Exact2'` The thermal has 2 spokes. |
    | [`str`](#keysight.ads.de._pde.tech.Thermal.Mode.str "keysight.ads.de._pde.tech.Thermal.Mode.str") | Return the string representation of the Thermal Mode. |

    USE\_DEFAULT *= 0*[](#keysight.ads.de._pde.tech.Thermal.Mode.USE_DEFAULT "Link to this definition")
    :   `'UseDefault'` Use the thermal mode defined in the default PadLayerEntry.

    FULL\_CONNECT *= 1*[](#keysight.ads.de._pde.tech.Thermal.Mode.FULL_CONNECT "Link to this definition")
    :   `'FullConnect'` The pad is fully connected to the plane. There is no thermal relief.

    STRAIGHT *= 3*[](#keysight.ads.de._pde.tech.Thermal.Mode.STRAIGHT "Link to this definition")
    :   `'Straight'` The thermal has 4 spokes. The clearance is drawn with straight lines.

    EXACT *= 4*[](#keysight.ads.de._pde.tech.Thermal.Mode.EXACT "Link to this definition")
    :   `'Exact'` The thermal has 4 spokes. The clearance is drawn with with rounded corners to keep exact distance.

    STRAIGHT\_2 *= 6*[](#keysight.ads.de._pde.tech.Thermal.Mode.STRAIGHT_2 "Link to this definition")
    :   `'Straight2'` The thermal has 2 spokes. The clearance is drawn with straight lines.

    EXACT\_2 *= 7*[](#keysight.ads.de._pde.tech.Thermal.Mode.EXACT_2 "Link to this definition")
    :   `'Exact2'` The thermal has 2 spokes. The clearance is drawn with with rounded corners to keep exact distance.

    *property* str[](#keysight.ads.de._pde.tech.Thermal.Mode.str "Link to this definition")
    :   Return the string representation of the Thermal Mode.
